description: This script automates downloading and repacking GitHub repository archives, including handling commit timestamps, hash verification, and submodule checks.

classes.name: Path
classes.description: Context manager for directory preparation, cleanup, and tarball operations.

classes.name: GitHubCommitTsCache
classes.description: Cache for storing and retrieving GitHub commit timestamps to avoid repeated API calls.

classes.name: DownloadGitHubTarball
classes.description: Handles downloading, verifying, and repacking GitHub repository tarballs, including commit timestamp retrieval.

methods.name: Path.__init__
methods.description: Initializes Path object with directory path and options.

methods.name: Path.__enter__
methods.description: Prepares directory on context entry, cleaning if preclean is set.

methods.name: Path.__exit__
methods.description: Cleans up directory on context exit unless keep is True.

methods.name: Path.mkdir_all
methods.description: Creates directory and parent directories like 'mkdir -p'.

methods.name: Path._rmdir_dir
methods.description: Removes directory and its contents.

methods.name: Path._mkdir
methods.description: Creates a directory if it does not exist.

methods.name: Path._rmdir
methods.description: Removes an empty directory.

methods.name: Path._remove
methods.description: Removes a file or symlink.

methods.name: Path._listdir
methods.description: Lists directory contents.

methods.name: Path._os_func
methods.description: Executes filesystem functions idempotently, handling specific errors.

methods.name: Path.rm_all
methods.description: Recursively removes files/directories or symlinks.

methods.name: Path.untar
methods.description: Extracts tarball into a directory, expecting a single subdirectory.

methods.name: Path.tar
methods.description: Creates a tarball from a directory or subdirectory, with optional timestamp.

methods.name: GitHubCommitTsCache.get
methods.description: Retrieves cached commit timestamp for a key.

methods.name: GitHubCommitTsCache.set
methods.description: Stores commit timestamp for a key.

methods.name: GitHubCommitTsCache._cache_init
methods.description: Initializes cache from file.

methods.name: GitHubCommitTsCache._cache_flush
methods.description: Writes cache to file.

methods.name: DownloadGitHubTarball.__init__
methods.description: Initializes download handler with parameters.

methods.name: DownloadGitHubTarball.download
methods.description: Performs download, unpacking, hash verification, and moving tarball.

methods.name: DownloadGitHubTarball._has_submodule
methods.description: Checks for presence of submodules in a directory.

methods.name: DownloadGitHubTarball._init_owner_repo
methods.description: Extracts owner and repo from URL.

methods.name: DownloadGitHubTarball._init_hasher
methods.description: Initializes hash object based on expected hash length.

methods.name: DownloadGitHubTarball._hash_check
methods.description: Verifies downloaded file hash matches expected.

methods.name: DownloadGitHubTarball._init_commit_ts
methods.description: Fetches commit timestamp via GitHub API.

methods.name: DownloadGitHubTarball._init_commit_ts_remote_get
methods.description: Fetches commit date from GitHub API.

methods.name: DownloadGitHubTarball._fetch
methods.description: Downloads tarball from GitHub.

methods.name: DownloadGitHubTarball._make_repo_url_path
methods.description: Constructs GitHub API URL.

methods.name: DownloadGitHubTarball._make_request
methods.description: Performs HTTPS request to GitHub API.

methods.name: DownloadGitHubTarball._error
methods.description: Creates error with source info.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Parses arguments and initiates download process.
